object_layers.label: Reusable Definition
object_layers.purpose: Versioned governed creature/NPC source object or role-safe projection.
object_layers.identity_rule: Stable definition identity is independent of display name, placement, or runtime instance.

object_layers.label: Presentation Profile
object_layers.purpose: Selects an information hierarchy appropriate to the authorized object's characteristics/context without redefining canonical identity.
object_layers.identity_rule: Profile ID is presentation metadata only.

object_layers.label: Variant / Template / Type-Modifier Relationship
object_layers.purpose: Relates source-backed siblings, stages, forms, templates, or modifier layers without flattening them into one identity.
object_layers.identity_rule: Every governed sibling or modifier retains its own source/version identity or explicit relationship receipt.

object_layers.label: Campaign / Scene Placement
object_layers.purpose: Campaign-local binding for quantity, label, visibility, notes, encounter role, starting assumptions, and permitted local overrides.
object_layers.identity_rule: placementId is distinct from source stable ID.

object_layers.label: Live Instance
object_layers.purpose: Runtime HP/resources/conditions/location/initiative/control state derived from an authorized launch/session context.
object_layers.identity_rule: Live instance ID is distinct from source definition and placement IDs.

object_layers.label: Playable Conversion / Reference
object_layers.purpose: Governed relationship from a creature source to playable-species/Character rules where supported.
object_layers.identity_rule: Conversion never means the playable Character/species is identical to the source creature instance.

object_layers.label: Source & Provenance
object_layers.purpose: Original source evidence, coordinates, transformations, source/recommendation distinction, conflicts, and validation history.
object_layers.identity_rule: Source evidence remains read-only and attributable.

presentation_profiles.label: Creature
presentation_profiles.selection_basis: Combat/ecology-focused governed object with no requirement for NPC-persona foregrounding.

presentation_profiles.label: NPC
presentation_profiles.selection_basis: Governed entity whose social identity, motives, relationships, faction/reputation, statements, or roleplay state materially matter.

presentation_profiles.label: Sentient Creature / NPC Hybrid
presentation_profiles.selection_basis: Creature mechanics and NPC-persona information are both materially relevant.

presentation_profiles.label: Swarm / Group
presentation_profiles.selection_basis: Source or governed relationship treats multiple members as a group-level encounter entity.

presentation_profiles.label: Summon / Minion / Spawn
presentation_profiles.selection_basis: Entity is materially governed by a summoner/master/spawn/controller relationship or bounded lifecycle.

presentation_profiles.label: Stage / Variant / Form
presentation_profiles.selection_basis: Object participates in a source-backed age, power, form, evolution, template, or sibling variant relationship.

presentation_profiles.label: Type / Affinity Modifier
presentation_profiles.selection_basis: Source-backed modifier layer adjusts resistances, vulnerabilities, abilities, environment adaptation, appearance, or related fields without necessarily creating a new base identity.

presentation_profiles.label: Playable Conversion
presentation_profiles.selection_basis: Source/governed rule explicitly maps a creature toward playable-species/Character construction.

experience_contexts.label: GM Authoring
experience_contexts.authoritative_mutation: only through the owning Campaign/content workflow, never the reference Inspector

experience_contexts.label: Encounter Preparation
experience_contexts.authoritative_mutation: Encounter draft/snapshot only; source definition immutable

experience_contexts.label: Live Runtime
experience_contexts.authoritative_mutation: through governed runtime action/event contracts only

experience_contexts.label: Exploration / Bestiary
experience_contexts.authoritative_mutation: discovery/reveal history only through owning workflow

experience_contexts.label: Playable Conversion
experience_contexts.authoritative_mutation: Character/species draft only through owning character workflow

assistant_gm.rule: projection is explicit delegation scope plus expiry; never unrestricted GM alias

creator_owner_admin.rule: governance inspection follows separate authority; administrative capability is not automatic Campaign-private entitlement

service_ai.rule: narrowest authorized projection only; AI read-only/proposal-only; unknown source facts remain unknown

accessibility_contract: semantic linear reading order equivalent to dense multi-column stat blocks
keyboard access to every action/ability/relationship/source affordance
screen-reader labels and announcements for state, variant, conflict, permission, and validation status
noncolor encoding for resistances, vulnerabilities, conditions, severity, and availability
high-zoom reflow without loss of primary action or status
compact GM density without reducing focus visibility or touch target requirements
reference_case_requirements: ordinary bestiary creature with combat plus behavior
sentient creature that needs both stat and persona foregrounding
